fato_historico: 1866: Armed Confederate veterans in New Orleans riot against a meeting of Radical Republicans, killing 48 people and injuring another 100.
energia_do_dia: The stars invite you to rise above any lingering discord today. Just as history reminds us that division only brings shadows, you may find that your natural gift for diplomacy is exactly what is needed now. Consider how you can mend bridges and nurture collaborative spirits, creating a serene space that reflects the light of your kind and balanced soul.
frase_do_dia: Peace begins within when you choose to plant seeds of unity.
significado_numero: A lucky number representing wisdom, inner searching, and spiritual growth.
conselho: Focus on active listening and choose words that build lasting bridges today.
